concepts/automatic-categorization-via-ba.title: Automatic categorization via backlinks
concepts/automatic-categorization-via-ba.description: Linking each wrong question to a knowledge-system note so the index can classify it automatically.

concepts/dashboard-数据总览.title: Dashboard (数据总览)
concepts/dashboard-数据总览.description: A Dataview-based overview page aggregating counts, recent entries, error types, and module breakdowns.

concepts/error-type-indexing.title: Error-type indexing
concepts/error-type-indexing.description: Organizing wrong questions by their error type so recurring mistake patterns become visible.

concepts/mastery-tracking.title: Mastery tracking
concepts/mastery-tracking.description: Using a mastery field (e.g., mastery = 0) to flag questions not yet mastered for review.

concepts/spaced-repetition-review-stages.title: Spaced Repetition Review Stages
concepts/spaced-repetition-review-stages.description: A stage-based review system (stages below 6 are scheduled) that spaces reviews of each word group over time.

concepts/一大一小看乘积.title: 一大一小看乘积
concepts/一大一小看乘积.description: 现期量与增长率一大一小时，比较两者乘积，乘积大的增长量大

concepts/一应俱全.title: 一应俱全
concepts/一应俱全.description: 强调'该有的都有'的齐备性，适用于商品、设施、物品齐全的场景。

concepts/一搭多验.title: 一搭多验
concepts/一搭多验.description: 用某一空与多个搭配对象逐一验证，以快速排除搭配不当选项。

concepts/三层分析法.title: 三层分析法
concepts/三层分析法.description: 逻辑填空核心框架：语境分析（定方向）→逻辑关系（找线索）→词语辨析（锁答案）。

concepts/三维度辨析法.title: 三维度辨析法
concepts/三维度辨析法.description: 从语义侧重、适用场景、程度三个维度区分近义成语的辨析方法，其中语义侧重维度最重要。

concepts/两期比例变化.title: 两期比例变化
concepts/两期比例变化.description: a>b比例上升、a<b比例下降、a=b不变；比重变化量=(A/B)×(a-b)/(1+a)

concepts/乘积增长率.title: 乘积增长率
concepts/乘积增长率.description: r = r₁ + r₂ + r₁×r₂，用于总量=单价×数量情形

concepts/二十大模型.title: 二十大模型
concepts/二十大模型.description: The book's framework of 20 canonical Data Analysis question models, each mapped to a dedicated page range.

concepts/交叉验证.title: 交叉验证
concepts/交叉验证.description: 当两个独立技巧推导出同一答案时，该答案可靠性极高的验证方法。

concepts/估算法.title: 估算法
concepts/估算法.description: 选项差距≥10%时，所有数值保留前2位有效数字

concepts/倍数.title: 倍数
concepts/倍数.description: Multiple ratio comparing one quantity to another.

concepts/做题检查流程-answer-checking-workflow.title: 做题检查流程 (Answer-Checking Workflow)
concepts/做题检查流程-answer-checking-workflow.description: The four-step process: identify question type, open the matching manual, eliminate traps per the manual, then reverse-derive the distractors.

concepts/八大题型分类.title: 八大题型分类
concepts/八大题型分类.description: 将逻辑填空错题划分为转折、并列递进、反义并列、解释对应、因果目的、成语辨析、政策搭配、引号比喻八类的分类索引体系。

concepts/公式记错-formula-error.title: 公式记错 (formula error)
concepts/公式记错-formula-error.description: Error type of inaccurate formula recall; improved by understanding derivations and periodic recitation.

concepts/分总结构.title: 分总结构
concepts/分总结构.description: 前文铺垫背景/问题/原因，尾句用'因此/可见/总之/可以说'引出结论的结构，主旨看尾句。

concepts/删除测试.title: 删除测试
concepts/删除测试.description: 把'此外'等补充部分删掉检验核心论证是否仍成立的方法，成立则说明其为补充而非主旨。

concepts/利润率.title: 利润率
concepts/利润率.description: 资料分析口径为 利润总额/营业收入，非成本利润率

concepts/削峰填谷.title: 削峰填谷
concepts/削峰填谷.description: Estimation technique that balances high and low values for easier mental calculation.

concepts/包罗万象.title: 包罗万象
concepts/包罗万象.description: 强调内容丰富、门类多、覆盖广度大，适用于学科、内容、范围广的场景。

concepts/十字交叉法.title: 十字交叉法
concepts/十字交叉法.description: Cross-multiplication method for solving mixed-rate and ratio problems.

concepts/反义并列型.title: 反义并列型
concepts/反义并列型.description: '不再A而是B'结构要求A与B严格反义，需先锁定反义更明确的一空。

concepts/同比环比.title: 同比/环比
concepts/同比环比.description: Year-over-year comparison vs. period-over-period (chain) comparison used to describe change in statistics.

concepts/名义增长与实际增长.title: 名义增长与实际增长
concepts/名义增长与实际增长.description: Nominal growth vs. real (inflation-adjusted) growth distinction.

concepts/因果目的型.title: 因果目的型
concepts/因果目的型.description: 后文目的/结果要求前文手段必须能达成该目的，用于反向验证选词。

concepts/坑点层.title: 坑点层
concepts/坑点层.description: Tag layer mapping tags to examiner-trick (pitfall) files that describe common wrong-answer traps.

concepts/坑点手册-pitfall-manual.title: 坑点手册 (Pitfall Manual)
concepts/坑点手册-pitfall-manual.description: A per-question-type checklist of common traps with an answering/checking process used to eliminate options one by one.

concepts/基期.title: 基期
concepts/基期.description: 题目要求的早于现期的时间

concepts/基期现期.title: 基期/现期
concepts/基期现期.description: Base period (reference period) and current period (present period) used in growth calculations.

concepts/增长率.title: 增长率
concepts/增长率.description: Growth rate, computed as growth amount divided by base period value.

concepts/增长贡献率与拉动增长率.title: 增长贡献率与拉动增长率
concepts/增长贡献率与拉动增长率.description: Metrics measuring how much a component contributes to overall growth.

concepts/增长量.title: 增长量
concepts/增长量.description: Growth amount, equal to current period minus base period, or base period times growth rate.

concepts/大大则大.title: 大大则大
concepts/大大则大.description: 现期量大且增长率大时，增长量一定大

concepts/存量指标.title: 存量指标
concepts/存量指标.description: 某个时点的瞬时数值，如年末存款余额、月末库存

concepts/实验目的-vs-实验发现.title: 实验目的 vs 实验发现
concepts/实验目的-vs-实验发现.description: 实验目的是'为什么做实验'（探索/研究+宏观目标），实验发现是'结果说明什么'（如何/怎样+具体机制）。

concepts/审题三步法.title: 审题三步法
concepts/审题三步法.description: The book's three-step method for reviewing/analyzing question stems before solving.

concepts/审题不仔细-careless-reading.title: 审题不仔细 (careless reading)
concepts/审题不仔细-careless-reading.description: Error type of misreading question requirements; improved by circling keywords and reading questions twice.

concepts/尾数法.title: 尾数法
concepts/尾数法.description: Addition/subtraction shortcut using the final digits of numbers.

concepts/干扰项六大类型.title: 干扰项六大类型
concepts/干扰项六大类型.description: 片面、以偏概全、偷换重心、过程当结论、无中生有、偷换概念，用于排除选项陷阱。

concepts/平均数.title: 平均数
concepts/平均数.description: Average value computed from a set of statistical figures.

concepts/年均增长基期.title: 年均增长基期
concepts/年均增长基期.description: 普通时间段基期=起始年；五年规划基期=规划前一年

concepts/年均增长率.title: 年均增长率
concepts/年均增长率.description: Average annual growth rate over multiple years.

concepts/年均增长量.title: 年均增长量
concepts/年均增长量.description: (现期量 - 基期量) / n，n为年份差

concepts/并列结构.title: 并列结构
concepts/并列结构.description: 用'一方面…另一方面'等标志或多角度展开的结构，无明确中心句，需自行概括共性。

concepts/并列递进型.title: 并列递进型
concepts/并列递进型.description: 并列找近义、递进找程度加重的题型，含并列因果倒置、并列+转折组合、双向vs单向等陷阱。

concepts/应有尽有.title: 应有尽有
concepts/应有尽有.description: 强调'没有遗漏'的齐备性，适用于设备、功能、种类齐全的场景。

concepts/引号比喻型.title: 引号比喻型
concepts/引号比喻型.description: 引号内比喻义/比喻实词的题型，引号仅放宽搭配限制而不改变词义核心侧重点。

concepts/必要条件结构.title: 必要条件结构
concepts/必要条件结构.description: '只有A才B/必须…才能…'结构，A是核心对策/前提，B是结果，重点在A。

concepts/总分结构.title: 总分结构
concepts/总分结构.description: 首句即观点、后文为解释/举例/原因的结构，主旨看首句，需从总起句中找主题词。

concepts/感情色彩分析.title: 感情色彩分析
concepts/感情色彩分析.description: 语境分析第一层：根据褒义/贬义/中性标志词排除色彩不符的选项。

concepts/感情色彩褒义贬义中性.title: 感情色彩（褒义/贬义/中性）
concepts/感情色彩褒义贬义中性.description: 词语所附带的褒奖、贬抑或中立的情感倾向，用于逻辑填空的色彩排除

concepts/成语辨析型.title: 成语辨析型
concepts/成语辨析型.description: 四个选项全为成语、需区分近义成语差异的题型。

concepts/成语辨析煞有介事-vs-义正词严.title: 成语辨析（煞有介事 vs 义正词严）
concepts/成语辨析煞有介事-vs-义正词严.description: 辨析外观相似（态度严肃）但感情色彩相反的两个成语：前者假装正经含讽刺，后者理直气壮为褒义

concepts/截位修正.title: 截位修正
concepts/截位修正.description: 选项差距<5%时，分母截位后反向修正误差

concepts/截位计算.title: 截位计算
concepts/截位计算.description: Truncation-based calculation that reduces digits to simplify multiplication/division.

concepts/掌握等级-mastery-levels.title: 掌握等级 (Mastery levels)
concepts/掌握等级-mastery-levels.description: Six-level ladder (新学/初识/熟悉/掌握/熟练/精通) mapping correct-answer counts to push intervals from 1 to 30 days.

concepts/搭配检验.title: 搭配检验
concepts/搭配检验.description: 通过词语与宾语的典型搭配（如'煞有介事地标注'）判断选项是否成立的验证方法

concepts/政策搭配型.title: 政策搭配型
concepts/政策搭配型.description: 政策类文段有固定官方表述（如'担纲主力''目标引领''XX驱动发展'），需专项积累。

concepts/文段拆解三问.title: 文段拆解三问
concepts/文段拆解三问.description: 阅读任何文段先回答三问：讲什么（锁定话题）、怎么讲（判断结构）、想说什么（定位中心句），顺序不可乱。

concepts/无所不包.title: 无所不包
concepts/无所不包.description: 强调'全部包含'、完全没有遗漏，程度最重、表述绝对，适用于知识、内容范围极广的场景。

concepts/时间分配不当-poor-time-allocation.title: 时间分配不当 (poor time allocation)
concepts/时间分配不当-poor-time-allocation.description: Error type of spending too long on one question; improved by strict timing and easy-first ordering.

concepts/显性对应与隐性对应.title: 显性对应与隐性对应
concepts/显性对应与隐性对应.description: 显性对应靠关联词直接在前后文找反义/近义；隐性对应无明显信号，需结合句间逻辑推导。

concepts/标签注册表.title: 标签注册表
concepts/标签注册表.description: Controlled-vocabulary registry of tags that must be used for tagging wrong questions, with strict no-invention rules.

concepts/核心话题.title: 核心话题
concepts/核心话题.description: 文段自始至终围绕展开的主体，通过反复出现的关键词识别，区别于背景信息和举例信息。

concepts/概念混淆-concept-confusion.title: 概念混淆 (concept confusion)
concepts/概念混淆-concept-confusion.description: Error type where similar concepts are mixed up; improved by comparative memorization and concrete examples.

concepts/母题汇总.title: 母题汇总
concepts/母题汇总.description: Compilation of 500 'mother' practice questions organized into 8 sections by test point.

concepts/比值增长率.title: 比值增长率
concepts/比值增长率.description: r = (a-b)/(1+b)，用于平均数/比值的同比增速

concepts/比重.title: 比重
concepts/比重.description: Proportion/share of a part within a whole in statistical data.

concepts/流量指标.title: 流量指标
concepts/流量指标.description: 一段时期的累计发生额，如全年GDP、1-6月社零

concepts/混合增长率.title: 混合增长率
concepts/混合增长率.description: Growth rate of a combined whole given growth rates of its parts.

concepts/特殊值法.title: 特殊值法
concepts/特殊值法.description: Using convenient special values (fractions/percentages) to speed up calculations.

concepts/特殊分数法.title: 特殊分数法
concepts/特殊分数法.description: 增长率≈1/n时，增长量=现期/(n+1)，减少量=现期/(n-1)

concepts/环比.title: 环比
concepts/环比.description: 与上一个相邻周期相比

concepts/百分点.title: 百分点
concepts/百分点.description: 两个百分数的差值，如增速从10%到12%上升2个百分点

concepts/直除法.title: 直除法
concepts/直除法.description: 选项差距<10%时，分子不动、分母保留前3位，除到能区分

concepts/知识图谱可视化-knowledge-graph-visuali.title: 知识图谱可视化 (knowledge graph visualization)
concepts/知识图谱可视化-knowledge-graph-visuali.description: Graph view of notes where heavily connected knowledge point nodes indicate weakest areas.

concepts/知识点层.title: 知识点层
concepts/知识点层.description: Tag layer mapping fine-grained tags to section headings in solution-system knowledge files.

concepts/粗心-carelessness.title: 粗心 (carelessness)
concepts/粗心-carelessness.description: Error type of sloppiness; improved by slowing down and using checking mechanisms.

concepts/维护规则.title: 维护规则
concepts/维护规则.description: Registry maintenance rule: new tags must be registered before use and propagated to knowledge/pitfall files.

concepts/考公错题本.title: 考公错题本
concepts/考公错题本.description: A personal civil service exam error notebook system combining an Obsidian vault, Memory MCP knowledge graph, and Python scripts.

concepts/考官派生手法.title: 考官派生手法
concepts/考官派生手法.description: 从正确答案反推干扰项生成方式：砍掉一半内涵、从单个问题反推对策、取递进尾句前半段当结论。

concepts/考官派生法-examiner-derivation-metho.title: 考官派生法 (Examiner Derivation Method)
concepts/考官派生法-examiner-derivation-metho.description: A reverse-thinking technique where, after answering, you explain every distractor option as a derivation of the correct answer to confirm your choice.

concepts/自适应复习系统.title: 自适应复习系统
concepts/自适应复习系统.description: A spaced-repetition style system that adjusts flashcard push frequency based on the learner's number of consecutive correct answers.

concepts/色彩排除法.title: 色彩排除法
concepts/色彩排除法.description: 依据文段整体感情色彩（如讽刺）排除褒义词或贬义过重词项的解题技巧

concepts/艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线-ebbinghaus-forgetting-.title: 艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线 (Ebbinghaus Forgetting Curve)
concepts/艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线-ebbinghaus-forgetting-.description: The memory model underlying the spaced-repetition review schedule implemented by the ebbinghaus.py script.

concepts/艾宾浩斯间隔复习-ebbinghaus-spaced-repe.title: 艾宾浩斯间隔复习 (Ebbinghaus spaced repetition)
concepts/艾宾浩斯间隔复习-ebbinghaus-spaced-repe.description: Review schedule with intervals of 1, 2, 4, 7, 15, and 30 days to reinforce learned material.

concepts/行测言语理解.title: 行测言语理解
concepts/行测言语理解.description: Verbal comprehension section of the Chinese civil service exam, covered by six question-type tag families.

concepts/补充结构.title: 补充结构
concepts/补充结构.description: 明确的结论句（因此后）之后还有'此外/另外'补充另一角度，但补充部分只是强化结论而非并列主旨。

concepts/解释对应型.title: 解释对应型
concepts/解释对应型.description: 空格前后的比喻、解释、冒号内容为直接语义提示的题型，优先匹配。

concepts/计算失误-calculation-error.title: 计算失误 (calculation error)
concepts/计算失误-calculation-error.description: Error type where the approach is right but arithmetic is wrong; improved by tidy scratch work and verifying key steps.

concepts/词义边界混淆主脉络与核心.title: 词义边界（混淆主脉络与核心）
concepts/词义边界混淆主脉络与核心.description: 分总·词义边界型错题中常见的坑，需区分'主脉络'与'核心'的词义边界（来自社团流派错题）。

concepts/词语辨析-word-discrimination.title: 词语辨析 (Word Discrimination)
concepts/词语辨析-word-discrimination.description: The practice of accumulating and distinguishing subtle differences between similar Chinese word groups to answer fill-in-the-blank questions.

concepts/语境对应.title: 语境对应
concepts/语境对应.description: 根据文段关键词（如'假装''编造'）选择语义和色彩与之匹配词语的技巧

concepts/语境范围分析.title: 语境范围分析
concepts/语境范围分析.description: 区分宏观（社会、国家、文明）与微观（个人、具体事物）语境以匹配用词。

concepts/资料分析.title: 资料分析
concepts/资料分析.description: Data analysis section of the exam with its own question-type, knowledge, and pitfall tags.

concepts/转折关系型.title: 转折关系型
concepts/转折关系型.description: 前后语义相反的题型，按'转折前后语义相反→选反义词'公式解题。

concepts/转折结构.title: 转折结构
concepts/转折结构.description: '但是/然而/却'之后是作者真正想说的内容，主旨看转折词后。

concepts/逆差.title: 逆差
concepts/逆差.description: 出口<进口，逆差额=进口-出口

concepts/递进结构.title: 递进结构
concepts/递进结构.description: 无结论标志词但有程度加深词（大大地/空前/渐趋/超越）层层推进到尾句末段的结构，主旨看末句。

concepts/逻辑填空-logical-fill-in-the-blank.title: 逻辑填空 (Logical Fill-in-the-blank)
concepts/逻辑填空-logical-fill-in-the-blank.description: A Chinese exam question type whose core skill is word discrimination.

concepts/逻辑填空解题体系.title: 逻辑填空解题体系
concepts/逻辑填空解题体系.description: 行测言语理解中基于七大逻辑关系与词义/色彩辨析的填空题解题方法体系

concepts/错题图谱.title: 错题图谱
concepts/错题图谱.description: An auto-generated atlas/index that groups wrong-answer questions by question type and error type.

concepts/错题图谱-wrong-question-map.title: 错题图谱 (Wrong-Question Map)
